threshold_note: All thresholds are coach heuristics tuned on recorded matches (rec3, rec5), not game rules. Distances are minimap fractions (map width = 1). An unread value never counts as safe or as evidence. fight_far starts where the positioning coach's help/join calls end (help_max_distance 0.45), so the two never describe the same fight.
killers_note: Per-hero advice for a repeat killer. Items are class names from data/items.json; the first affordable one not owned is suggested, else the cheapest not owned. Victor's Aura and Drifter's Stalker's Mark / Rend are spirit damage over time that 'can be dispelled' (deadlock.wiki).
roles_note: Only heroes whose range is stated on their deadlock.wiki page are listed; unlisted heroes get no range advice.

source.excerpt: harasses his enemies with arrows and spirit from long range

close_sources_note: Death-panel sources that only hit you up close (wiki: the aura has an 8m radius; Rend deals bonus melee damage in close range).
generic_sources_note: Death-panel rows that name no single hero; never attributed.

cards.speech: You're in {hero}'s Aura of Suffering: it hurts more the longer you stay. Back out of its range now.
cards.rationale: The debuff badge proves you are inside the 8m aura; its damage ramps up while you stay.

sources.excerpt: The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
Get too close and risk getting caught in his Aura of Suffering

cards.speech: {hero}'s Stalker's Mark is on you: he can appear behind you. Stand next to a teammate and keep your escape.
cards.rationale: A marked, isolated hero is Drifter's ideal target: the mark lets him teleport behind you and Bloodscent amplifies damage on isolated heroes.

sources.excerpt: While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.
You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes

cards.speech: Stunned and losing health. The moment it ends, use your escape and break line of sight.
cards.rationale: A stun while health falls means you are being focused; the escape held in reserve is what saves you.

sources.excerpt: hold defense for when focused
Debuff Reducer/Dispel Magic/Divine Barrier vs DoT or CC

cards.speech: Silenced and losing health: no abilities for a moment. Back off behind cover until it wears off.
cards.rationale: Without abilities you cannot trade back; leaving the fight until the silence ends avoids a one-sided exchange.

sources.excerpt: hold defense for when focused
Weapon heroes avoid walking into control for one extra shot

cards.speech: Knocked off the zipline under fire. Don't fight here: get behind cover and back to your team.
cards.rationale: Being knocked off a zipline drops you where the enemy chose to fight, usually alone.

sources.excerpt: Fall back and regroup. Don't fight split.

cards.speech: {count} enemies are dead for {secs} more seconds. Group up and push {lane} now.
cards.rationale: Greyed enemy portraits with long timers are a numbers advantage; on your own half with good health, the wave furthest toward their base converts it.

sources.excerpt: count survivors and take the highest-value safe action (objective, wave, reset) rather than chasing

sources.section: ## 10. Chasing kills instead of taking objectives
sources.excerpt: They are dead. Take the Walker now.

cards.speech: You're in base holding {souls} souls. Spend them before you walk out.
cards.rationale: The base shop is the safe moment to buy; walking out unspent takes the fight without that power.

sources.excerpt: Do not hoard souls through fights; buy during respawn or at the base.
Spend steadily and stay alive; hoarding for one expensive item while dying is a trap (metabot).

cards.speech: You're heading out at {pct}% health. Heal before your next fight: standing in base restores health fast.
cards.rationale: Shopping does not heal; base regeneration does, quickly.

sources.excerpt: Standing in base will quickly regenerate the player's health (adding +60 health per second and +6% of max health per second), allowing them to recover from fights.

cards.speech: You carry {souls} unsecured souls {why}. Don't die with them: back off until they secure.
cards.rationale: Haunted souls are lost on death; they convert over time, so surviving the next seconds keeps them.

sources.excerpt: haunted souls are lost on death and drop in a Soul Bag only above 50 + 5/min.
Haunted souls convert to secured at 0.5%/s of the current haunted total plus a flat base

cards.rationale: The same enemy doing the most damage in several deaths is a pattern to answer with positioning and one defensive item.

sources.excerpt: dying repeatedly to same damage type
defense if one pattern kills you
DoT heroes -> debuff removers

cards.speech: {count} of your deaths came up close. You're a long-range hero: fight from max range behind your front line.
cards.rationale: A long-range hero dying mostly to melee and close-range damage is fighting at the enemy's range.

sources.excerpt: He uses traps and brief flight to maintain his distance
damage dealers behind with escape lanes; do not stand in front of your tank

cards.speech: Your team is fighting {allies} against {enemies} at {area} without you. Rotate there now if your wave is safe.
cards.rationale: A team fight on the minimap far from you is fought a hero short.

sources.excerpt: A fight entered with team split or a teammate still walking from base is usually lost (metabot).
Fall back and regroup. Don't fight split.
